title: Which key opens Skills
caption: At Lv 4 the Next up card that spends skill points now says "Open Skills: press K", the game's default key.

title: Key on the Skills card
caption: Once Skills opens at Lv 4, the Skills card shows its K key on the points line.

title: Keys on desktop
caption: At Lv 13, after Urgent Pursuit, the Skills card shows K and the Daevanion card U; Next up's skill card says which key to press.
